lines.text: The six-forty never made it to the next station.
[quiet, tired] I didn't sleep. I set an alarm anyway.
[softly, a small smile] Five-forty. I bought two coffees... because I didn't know how he takes his.
lines.show: 5:40. I bought two coffees... because I didn't know how he takes his.

lines.text: [low] Platform four. He was already there.
[surprised, then a slow smile] Mira? ...Do you live around here?
[too fast, nervous] No. Yes. Sort of. I brought you coffee.
[amused] You don't even know how I take it.
[a little laugh] That's why there's two.
[tense, quiet] Then the six-forty pulled in. Right on time.
lines.show: Then the 6:40 pulled in. Right on time.

lines.text: [gently] That's me. Thanks for the coffee.
[rushed] I didn't have a plan. So I tripped.
[shocked, then laughing] Okay. That's twice now. Are you doing this on purpose?
[soft] The doors closed. The train left without him.
[low] An hour later, every phone in the café buzzed at once.
[shaken, quiet] The six-forty never made it to the next station.
lines.show: The 6:40 never made it to the next station.

lines.text: [quiet, staring at her] You knew. Didn't you?
[hesitant] I couldn't tell him. Not yet.
[uneasy] That night, at eleven eleven... it wasn't my phone that lit up.
lines.show: That night, at 11:11… it wasn't my phone that lit up.

lines.text: [barely a whisper, confused] Mira... why is your voice on my phone?
